title: Fix streamed tool calls that omit index

files.patch:
@@ -1616,6 +1616,28 @@ def build_kwargs(self, prompt, stream):
         return kwargs
 
 
+def _streamed_tool_call_index(tool_calls, tool_call):
+    """Key for one streamed tool-call delta.
+
+    OpenAI sends an integer index. Some compatible endpoints omit it and
+    repeat id and name on every argument fragment. An id already seen
+    continues that call; a new id, or a name with no id, starts one;
+    anything else continues the most recent call.
+    """
+    idx = tool_call.index
+    if idx is not None:
+        return idx
+    if tool_call.id:
+        for existing_idx, existing in tool_calls.items():
+            if existing.id == tool_call.id:
+                return existing_idx
+    if not tool_calls:
+        return 0
+    if tool_call.id or tool_call.function.name:
+        return max(tool_calls) + 1
+    return max(tool_calls)
+

+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("async_", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "fragments,expected",
+    [
+        (
+            [
+                ("call_first", "first", '{"value":'),
+                (None, None, "1}"),
+                ("call_second", "second", '{"value":'),
+                (None, None, "2}"),
+            ],
+            [
+                ("call_first", "first", {"value": 1}),
+                ("call_second", "second", {"value": 2}),
+            ],
+        ),
+        # Gemini repeats id and name on each argument fragment and omits index.
+        (
+            [
+                ("call_split", "lookup", '{"value":'),
+                ("call_split", "lookup", "1}"),
+            ],
+            [
+                ("call_split", "lookup", {"value": 1}),
+            ],
+        ),
+    ],
+)
+async def test_streaming_tool_calls_without_index(
+    httpx2_mock, async_, fragments, expected
+):
+    # Some OpenAI-compatible endpoints omit "index" on streamed tool calls
+    import json
+
+    from pytest_httpx2 import IteratorStream
+
+    chunks = []
+    for call_id, name, arguments in fragments:
+        tool_call = {
+            "type": "function",
+            "function": {"name": name, "arguments": arguments},
+        }
+        if call_id:
+            tool_call["id"] = call_id
+        chunk = {
+            "id": "chat_test",
+            "object": "chat.completion.chunk",
+            "created": 0,
+            "model": "gpt-4.1-mini",
+            "choices": [{"index": 0, "delta": {"tool_calls": [tool_call]}}],
+        }
+        chunks.append(("data: " + json.dumps(chunk) + "\n\n").encode())
+    chunks.append(b"data: [DONE]\n\n")
+    httpx2_mock.add_response(
+        url="https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions",
+        stream=IteratorStream(chunks),
+        headers={"Content-Type": "text/event-stream"},
+    )
+    model = (llm.get_async_model if async_ else llm.get_model)("gpt-4.1-mini")
+    response = model.prompt("Call both tools", key=API_KEY, stream=True)
+    if async_:
+        [event async for event in response.astream_events()]
+        calls = await response.tool_calls()
+    else:
+        list(response.stream_events())
+        calls = response.tool_calls()
+    assert [
+        (call.tool_call_id, call.name, call.arguments) for call in calls
+    ] == expected
